slides.title: residents of Sahla Seyemt woreda directly hit by drought
slides.body: Local officials say rains failed for consecutive seasons.

slides.title: Families are leaving home
slides.body: Church officials say new arrivals sleep outdoors near a church in Sekota, then move on toward Raya.

slides.title: quintals of grain allocated to the zone, the Amhara commission says
slides.body: Food distributions target 66,000+ people in five woredas.

slides.title: Not enough, residents say
slides.body: Locals warn rations fall short after total crop failure, and call for more food and medical aid.
